tracking_slots.reason: slot lifecycle (status, claim/completion times, cancellation reason, plan and job) has no SQLite column

instagram_caption_tags.reason: original hashtag spellings: the target keeps normalized names only

instagram_caption_captured_at.reason: derived from the caption window end, so the expiry instant is unchanged

youtube_payload_text.reason: payload re-serialized canonically; its original SHA-256 stays in item_snapshots.payload_hash

rss_raw_response.reason: the raw RSS feed body is not kept on the target: recovered runs carry raw_response NULL

runtime_ownership.reason: write ownership of the target itself (bookkeeping without a SQLite counterpart)

runtime_participants.reason: process leases of the target writers (bookkeeping without a SQLite counterpart)

quota_usage_ledger.reason: a copy of SQLite's own legacy call tables; the Oracle period's usage returns as quota_reservations/quota_charges

quota_accounts.reason: usage verification stamps of the Oracle runtime (no SQLite counterpart)

writer_transfer_events.reason: writer transfer and release history of the target; the usage itself goes to SQLite by usage_handover
